Elena: quick follow-up from the postmortem - we've seen a recurring data-loss pattern in three separate incidents. need owners, jira links, and a short handoff plan so remediation doesn't stall.
Marcus: i'll take investigation (R). creating ticket RWD-11011 now. will post repro steps and minimal test harness by Tue.
Yuki: i'll own alerting & runbook (C). i'll propose a new alert for write-confirmation miss rate and add a rollback play. opening RWD-11012.
Ben: i'll own the patch + rollout (A). creating RWD-11013 and sketching a canary plan (10% of traffic, 72h).
Elena: proposed RACI: Marcus=R, Ben=A, Yuki=C, Elena=I (pm). agree?
Marcus: confirmed. early triage: observed incomplete commit windows when concurrent compactions overlap with high write pressure. sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T07:52:10Z writer-7 error: commit_timeout id=abc123 window_ms=1200 pending=42
2026-03-21T07:52:11Z compactor-2 info: compaction_start shard=12 dur_ms=900
```
Marcus: short next steps on RWD-11011: (1) reproduce in perf sandbox (2) add fine-grained write-confirm metrics (3) test small config tweak to commit timeout and compaction scheduling.
Ben: mitigation plan in RWD-11013: (1) stagger compaction windows, (2) increase commit_ack timeout by 500ms as a safe short-term measure, (3) canary on subset with synthetic write load.
Yuki: alerting plan RWD-11012: create warning for write_confirm_miss_rate > 0.5% for 5m and page if >1% for 2m. add dashboard and runbook with rollback steps.
Elena: gating: no cluster-wide rollout until canary shows write_confirm_miss_rate <= baseline and error counts stable for 48h. add gating to all three tickets.
Marcus: adding gating to RWD-11011, linking RWD-11012 and RWD-11013. triage doc will include exact repro script.
Ben: draft PR up, linking RWD-11013. assigning Marcus & Yuki for review. small config change + tests.
ops-bot: Created Jira tickets RWD-11011 (investigation), RWD-11012 (alerting), RWD-11013 (remediation). Created recurring event "Data-loss remediation sync" every Wed 09:30 PT until closed. Invitations sent to Marcus, Ben, Yuki, Elena.
Yuki: added gating note to RWD-11012 and linked the runbook. i'll watch alerts during canary and escalate if it deviates. :eyes:
Marcus: will hand off investigation results and traces to Ben after validation. Ben will own rollout and monitoring during canary.
Ben: noted. target timeline: triage -> PR -> canary (72h) -> staged rollout within 12 business days.
Elena: please add a short recurrence summary to the postmortem doc so oncall knows history. leaving thread open for blockers. :thumbsup:
